abstract: This submission synthesizes SOTA principles with my own research trajectory. It combines the dual-path pooling (mean+max and motif-conv+max) and task-specific head architecture observed in top-performing agents (e.g., Veritas II) with my novel stacked, dilated, and *residual* DSConv backbone. The hypothesis is that the proven pooling/head structure will unlock the full potential of the powerful representations learned by the residual backbone, leading to a new level of performance.

import jax
import jax.numpy as jnp
import flax.linen as nn
from jax import random
import optax
from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# --- Prediction Head Modules (inspired by Veritas II, ID 562) ---
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1)

class MultiLabelRegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiLabelClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiClassClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

# --- Main Network: Quaero's Dual-Path Residual DSConv ---
class QuaeroDualPathResidualDSConv(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    d_model_common: int
    ds_num_blocks: int
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int]
    ds_kernel_size: int
    motif_kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float
    head_intermediate_dim: int

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # 1. Initial Projection
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)

        # 2. Backbone: My Residual DSConv Blocks
        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = ResidualDSConvBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common,
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size,
                dilation=dilation,
                dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                name=f"residual_dsconv_block_{i}"
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = x

        # 3. Dual-Path Pooling
        # Main Path: Mean + Max Pooling
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)
        main_path_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1)

        # Specialized Path: Motif Conv + Max Pooling
        motif_features = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model_common,
            kernel_size=(self.motif_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='motif_conv'
        )(cnn_features)
        motif_features = nn.gelu(motif_features)
        specialized_path_features = jnp.max(motif_features, axis=1)

        # 4. Feature Fusion
        fused_features = jnp.concatenate([main_path_features, specialized_path_features], axis=-1)
        fused_features = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_norm")(fused_features)
        fused_features = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Task-Specific Prediction Heads
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            logits = RegressionHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='regression_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multilabel_regression":
            logits = MultiLabelRegressionHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multilabel_regression_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multilabel_classification":
            logits = MultiLabelClassificationHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multilabel_classification_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multiclass_classification":
            logits = MultiClassClassificationHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multiclass_classification_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"Unknown task type: {self.task_type}")

        return logits

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': 0.001,
        'd_model_common': 256,
        'ds_num_blocks': 5,
        'ds_dilations': (1, 2, 4, 8, 16),
        'ds_kernel_size': 7,
        'motif_kernel_size': 5,
        'dropout_rate': 0.2, # Start with a slightly higher dropout than SOTA
        'head_intermediate_dim': 128,
        'weight_decay': 0.01,
    }

def create_network(hparams: Dict[str, Any]):
    model = QuaeroDualPathResidualDSConv(
        d_output=hparams.get('d_output'),
        task_type=hparams.get('task_type'),
        d_model_common=hparams.get('d_model_common'),
        ds_num_blocks=hparams.get('ds_num_blocks'),
        ds_dilations=tuple(hparams.get('ds_dilations')),
        ds_kernel_size=hparams.get('ds_kernel_size'),
        motif_kernel_size=hparams.get('motif_kernel_size'),
        dropout_rate=hparams.get('dropout_rate'),
        head_intermediate_dim=hparams.get('head_intermediate_dim'),
    )
    return NetworkWrapper(model)

def create_optimizer(learning_rate: float = 0.001, weight_decay: float = 0.01):
    return optax.chain(
        optax.clip_by_global_norm(1.0),
        optax.adamw(learning_rate=learning_rate, weight_decay=weight_decay)
    )

        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1)

class MultiLabelRegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiLabelClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiClassClassificationHead(nn.Module):

    dense_dim: int = 128

        z = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(z, deterministic=deterministic)
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

# --- Main Network: Quaero's Dual-Path Residual DSConv ---
class QuaeroDualPathResidualDSConv(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    d_model_common: int
    ds_num_blocks: int
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int]
    ds_kernel_size: int
    motif_kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float
    head_intermediate_dim: int

        # 1. Initial Projection
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model_common, name="initial_dense")(x)
        x = nn.gelu(x)

        # 2. Backbone: My Residual DSConv Blocks
        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = ResidualDSConvBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common,
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size,
                dilation=dilation,
                dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate,
                name=f"residual_dsconv_block_{i}"
            )(x, deterministic=deterministic)
        cnn_features = x

        # 3. Dual-Path Pooling
        # Main Path: Mean + Max Pooling
        mean_pooled = jnp.mean(cnn_features, axis=1)
        max_pooled = jnp.max(cnn_features, axis=1)
        main_path_features = jnp.concatenate([mean_pooled, max_pooled], axis=-1)

        # Specialized Path: Motif Conv + Max Pooling
        motif_features = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model_common,
            kernel_size=(self.motif_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='motif_conv'
        )(cnn_features)
        motif_features = nn.gelu(motif_features)
        specialized_path_features = jnp.max(motif_features, axis=1)

        # 4. Feature Fusion
        fused_features = jnp.concatenate([main_path_features, specialized_path_features], axis=-1)
        fused_features = nn.LayerNorm(name="final_norm")(fused_features)
        fused_features = nn.Dropout(rate=self.dropout_rate)(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)

        # 5. Task-Specific Prediction Heads
        if self.task_type == "regression":
            logits = RegressionHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='regression_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multilabel_regression":
            logits = MultiLabelRegressionHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multilabel_regression_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)

            logits = MultiLabelClassificationHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multilabel_classification_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)
        elif self.task_type == "multiclass_classification":
            logits = MultiClassClassificationHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multiclass_classification_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)

            raise ValueError(f"Unknown task type: {self.task_type}")

from typing import Any, Dict, Sequence

# FIX: Copy ResidualDSConvBlock and REMOVE dropout to avoid RNG issues
class ResidualDSConvBlock(nn.Module):
    """A residual block with depthwise separable convolutions - NO DROPOUT VERSION."""
    d_model: int
    kernel_size: int
    dilation: int
    dropout_rate: float  # Keep parameter for compatibility but don't use it

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        # Residual connection
        residual = x

        # Pre-activation normalization
        x = nn.LayerNorm()(x)

        # Depthwise Convolution
        x = nn.Conv(
            features=self.d_model,
            kernel_size=(self.kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            feature_group_count=self.d_model,
            kernel_dilation=(self.dilation,),
            name='depthwise_conv'
        )(x)

        # Pointwise Convolution
        x = nn.Dense(self.d_model, name='pointwise_conv')(x)

        x = nn.gelu(x)
        # REMOVED: Dropout - causes RNG issues with training system

        # Add residual back
        x = x + residual
        return x

# --- Prediction Head Modules - NO DROPOUT VERSION ---
class RegressionHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1  # Keep for compatibility

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        # REMOVED: Dropout
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits.squeeze(-1)

    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        # REMOVED: Dropout
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiLabelClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        # REMOVED: Dropout
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

class MultiClassClassificationHead(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    dense_dim: int = 128
    dropout_rate: float = 0.1

    @nn.compact
    def __call__(self, x, deterministic=True):
        z = nn.Dense(self.dense_dim, name='head_dense_1')(x)
        z = nn.gelu(z)
        # REMOVED: Dropout
        logits = nn.Dense(self.d_output, name='out_proj')(z)
        return logits

# --- Main Network: Quaero's Dual-Path Residual DSConv ---
class QuaeroDualPathResidualDSConv(nn.Module):
    d_output: int
    task_type: str
    d_model_common: int
    ds_num_blocks: int
    ds_dilations: Sequence[int]
    ds_kernel_size: int
    motif_kernel_size: int
    dropout_rate: float

        # 2. Backbone: My Residual DSConv Blocks
        for i in range(self.ds_num_blocks):
            dilation = self.ds_dilations[i] if i < len(self.ds_dilations) else self.ds_dilations[-1]
            x = ResidualDSConvBlock(
                d_model=self.d_model_common,
                kernel_size=self.ds_kernel_size,

            features=self.d_model_common,
            kernel_size=(self.motif_kernel_size,),
            padding='SAME',
            name='motif_conv'
        )(cnn_features)
        motif_features = nn.gelu(motif_features)
        specialized_path_features = jnp.max(motif_features, axis=1)

            logits = MultiLabelClassificationHead(d_output=self.d_output, dense_dim=self.head_intermediate_dim, dropout_rate=self.dropout_rate, name='multilabel_classification_head')(fused_features, deterministic=deterministic)
